o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bōl- (“to become”). See there for cognates.

From Proto-Turkic *kïsgač,from *kïs- (“to squeeze, to pinch”) + *-gač, equivalent to qıs- (“to squeeze”) + -qac. Cognates with Turkish kıskaç, Karakhanid قِسْغاجْ (qısɣač), Karaim кыскач, Kazakh қысқыш (qısqıš), Tatar кыскыч (qısqıç), Turkmen gysgyç, Uyghur قىسقاچ (qisqach), Uzbek qisqich.
